scripts.preeas:build:preview: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-build-number && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-version

scripts.eas-build-pre-install: node -e "const p=process.env.EAS_BUILD_PROFILE; if(p==='production'){ if(!process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN){ console.error('ERROR: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is not set in the EAS production environment. Source map uploads will fail. Register it via: eas env:create --environment production --name SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN --type secret'); process.exit(1); } console.log('SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is present (production build) — source map upload enabled.'); } else { console.log('Non-production profile ('+p+') — skipping SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN check.'); }"
